title: poker: betting round state machine
description: No betting round FSM exists. A poker betting round needs: (1) track current_bet amount per round, (2) track each active player's contribution this round, (3) track who has acted since the last raise, (4) end condition: all active players have acted and all contributions equal current_bet (or player is all-in). The Phase with type='betting_round' should trigger this FSM. The ends_when field from BettingRound definition should drive termination. Without this, multi-player betting sequences cannot execute correctly. Tests: test_betting_round_ends_when_bets_equal in tests/test_poker.py.
